literal: Even though revolving, behind the plough is the world; therefore, even with toil, agriculture indeed is foremost.
translation: Though the world wanders through many diverse occupations, it must ultimately follow the plough; therefore, despite the hard toil it demands, agriculture is the foremost occupation.
modern: உலகம் பல தொழில்களில் சுழன்று திரிந்தாலும் ஏரின் பின்னாலேயே செல்ல வேண்டியிருக்கிறது; அதனால், எவ்வளவு துன்பப்பட்டு உழைத்தாலும் உழவுத் தொழிலே முதன்மையானது ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet establishes the supreme importance of agriculture over all other professions. The poet notes that although people wander and engage in various trades to make a living, the entire world ultimately depends on the food produced by the plough. The word 'suḻaṉṟum' suggests the restless wandering of humanity in search of livelihoods, which always leads back to the soil. Therefore, despite the physical hardship and intense labor implied by 'uḻantum', farming remains the most vital and noble pursuit.
